headline: Marchetti Mills appoints new plant head at Biella unit
body: Marchetti Mills SpA has appointed a new plant head to oversee operations at its Biella facility, as part of a routine leadership refresh across its manufacturing sites.

headline: Nordkrans scales back operations at Malmo unit
body: Nordkrans Steel Traders AB has scaled back production at its Malmo facility, citing softer demand in the regional steel trading segment.

headline: Vendors say Larsson Distributors has fallen behind on payments
body: Multiple suppliers to Larsson Distributors AB say the Gothenburg-based pharma distributor has fallen behind on scheduled payments over the past quarter, raising concerns among its vendor base.

headline: Workers at Oakhurst Components plant protest over delayed wages
body: Workers at Oakhurst Components Ltd's Birmingham plant staged a protest this week over delayed wage payments, with union representatives warning of further action if dues are not cleared.

headline: Workers at Kessler Logistics warehouse protest over delayed wages
body:
Warehouse staff at Kessler Logistics GmbH stopped work at the Dortmund depot over wages they said were several weeks late.

The third-party logistics operator runs distribution centres across North Rhine-Westphalia and is not engaged in commodity trading. Management said a payroll transfer had been held up and would be released this week.

headline: Workers at Kessler Traders plant protest over delayed wages
body: Workers at Kessler Traders GmbH's Essen facility staged a protest this week over delayed wage payments, with union representatives warning of further action if dues are not cleared.

headline: Northpoint Industrial Holdings in restructuring talks with lenders
body:
Northpoint Industrial Holdings Ltd has opened discussions with its lenders on restructuring part of its consolidated debt, according to three people aware of the process.

The group, which holds interests across packaging and textiles, has seen consolidated cash flows tighten over the past three quarters. Two of the people said the talks cover extension of repayment schedules on facilities held at the holding-company level.

Group operating entities have continued to fund working capital from internal accruals, though one person said intra-group support had become harder to arrange. The company did not respond to queries.
